name: Chocolate, Graham Cracker & Marshmallow "S'mores" Sheep Cupcakes

instructions.primary_message: This recipe uses Duncan Hines Devil's Food cake mix; if using a different brand please adjust recipe ingredients and cooking times per package instructions.
TO MAKE THE CUPCAKES: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line two 12-cup muffin pans with paper liners and set aside. (Or bake in batches if necessary.)
Place cake mix, eggs, water, and oil in a medium bowl. Using a hand-held mixer, blend on medium for 2 minutes, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (432 g) box devil's food cake mix
½ cup neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Place graham crackers in another medium bowl and break into small pieces using a potato masher or wooden spoon. Add cracker pieces to the batter and stir once more to combine.

Fill muffin liners half-full with batter (about ¼-cup each). Place in the preheated oven and bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 19-23 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely, about 1 hour.
TO DECORATE THE CUPCAKES:  Count out 12 large marshmallows, then cut in half lengthwise. Place on a plate, sticky-side up, and set aside.
Remove one tablespoon of frosting and set aside for later use, then use a butter knife to spread remaining frosting over the top of each cupcake in an even layer.

Press a large marshmallow half, sticky-side down, into the side of a cupcake, creating the "head" of the "sheep." Arrange mini marshmallows over the remaining frosting, creating the "wool." Attach candy eyes with a small dot of the reserved frosting, then use black writing icing to add details as desired. Repeat with remaining cupcakes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (283 g) pkg mini marshmallows
1 (82 g) pkg mini candy eyeballs
1 (37 g) tube black writing icing or gel

instructions.primary_message: Arrange sheep cupcakes on a platter and enjoy!
